![World of Warcards — a card binder for World of Warcraft: Forever](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/main/docs/media/banner.png)

# World of Warcards

Find cards from mobs, dungeon bosses and gathering nodes while you play **World of Warcraft: Forever**. Keep them in your binder, open packs, trade your spares and work towards collection achievements.

**[Download](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/download)** · **[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/world-of-warcards)** · **[Website](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/)** · **[Help](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/help)** · **[Discord](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/discord)** · **[Report a problem](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/issues/new/choose)**

Free and open source. Built for **Forever**; Retail and other Classic clients are not currently supported.

> [!WARNING]
> **Known issue: DX12 loading screens.** Some Forever players experience a loading-screen hang with repeated desktop flickering. Warcards' 3D models may make this issue more likely or worse. Version 1.0.10 reduces preload-scene allocation, but is **not a confirmed fix**. Read the [known issues and troubleshooting steps](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/KNOWN-ISSUES.md) before installing.
> If chat still works during the loop, try `/reload`; this has recovered an affected session. Otherwise a full client restart may be needed. These are temporary workarounds.

## Your collection, in game

Browse cards by zone or dungeon, see what you’re missing and take a closer look at your favourites. Some cards have separate collectible editions with different poses or animations.

Want to open straight to where you’re playing? Enable **Settings → General → Open binder at current zone**. It finds your current zone or dungeon collection and keeps your previous page in places without one.

### A card with a story

That lucky find can keep its story. New copies remember **who found them, where and when**, even after a gift or trade. Inspect a copy's history in your binder, in a trade offer or in another collector's shared binder. Have several copies? Choose the one you want to pass on. Older cards stay marked as unrecorded.

### Community bonus events

Make an evening of the hunt. Scheduled bonus hours can boost every collection or send everyone after cards from particular zones and dungeons. When an event starts, a sound and chat notice let you know; the binder shows the bonus and the time left beside its title.

Events are for companion-connected **Ranked** binders. Sync and load the schedule with `/reload` before it starts, then the bonus starts and ends automatically. Watch Discord for announced dates—installing the update does not start an event.

Seasonal collections give everyone a shared list to hunt for alongside their normal Ranked binder. Finish in time for titles and packs, with extra rewards for the first finishers. Cards held back from the launch collection can return through seasons; copies you already own stay yours.

![The collection index with an undiscovered Wiry Swoop card selected.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/main/docs/media/gallery/binder.png)

| Trade cards and packs | Earn achievements and titles |
|:---:|:---:|
| ![The card trade window with a Dragonmaw Bonewarder offered.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/main/docs/media/gallery/trading.png) | ![Collection achievements showing card and set progress.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/main/docs/media/gallery/achievements.png) |
| Swap spares or send a gift. Both players accept before anything moves. | Collect cards, finish sets and work towards titles. |

### Build a guild binder

Open **Guild** to browse the full shared binder, including missing slots. **Add cards** opens your personal binder at a spare copy. Select several cards, then **Review selected** to remove entries, check last-copy warnings and confirm the batch. No cards leave until you confirm.

Use **Guild index** at the top to return from any section. **Cancel donation** clears your selection and returns there without moving cards. Confirmed cards show their latest donating character; older donations may not have a recorded name.

Donations are permanent. Nobody can withdraw cards, and they stay with the guild if you leave. Pending copies are labelled **Waiting for sync** and do not increase confirmed guild progress or points. Keep companion **1.0.8** open, then use **Save & sync** once for the batch and **Refresh after sync** when it finishes.

Create or join through the companion. New guild binders are ready immediately; their owner approves members. Forever uses first names and surnames, so different surnames can join the same guild. [Guild setup](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/help#guilds) · [Guild standings](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/guilds).

### Collect together

The Fellowship set rewards the things you do with other players: trading, gifting, donating to your guild binder and sitting at a campfire. Collect all four for the Better Together achievement and Fellow Traveler title.

### Campfire bonus

Sit by a campfire before the next hunt. While its camp buff is active, your chance of finding **Common and Rare creature cards is doubled**. The buff tooltip explains the bonus where the client allows it, with a movable timer icon as a fallback. It is another reason to gather your friends before heading back out.

### Keep packs in your satchel

Zone packs stay sealed in the Warcards Satchel until you open or trade them. Common packs hold one card, Rare packs three and Epic packs five, all from the pack’s zone.

![The Warcards Satchel, shown empty before any packs have been found.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/main/docs/media/gallery/satchel.png)

## Start collecting

1. Download the **addon ZIP** from [Downloads](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/download) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/releases/latest). Use the release file, rather than GitHub’s “Code → Download ZIP”.
2. Close the game. Extract the `AzerothCardBinder` folder into your Forever installation:

   ```text
   World of Warcraft/
     _forever_/
       Interface/
         AddOns/
           AzerothCardBinder/
             AzerothCardBinder.toc
   ```

3. Enable **World of Warcards** in the character screen’s AddOns list. Open it from the minimap, or type `/acb`.

You can collect in **Casual** mode with just the addon. For **Ranked** play and online syncing, install the companion app too. The [setup guide](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/help#install) covers both.

## The companion app

The Windows app connects your saved binder to the server. Sign in with Discord, choose your game folder and keep it running while you play. It syncs after `/reload` or logout and checks for addon and app updates.

![The Windows companion app signed in with a synced Ranked binder.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/main/docs/media/gallery/companion.png)

- **Windows 64-bit.** Installs for your user without administrator rights.
- **Public or private.** Choose whether your binder appears on the website.
- **File-based syncing.** Reads the addon’s saved data and writes its update file; it does not read game memory or automate play.
- **Checkable downloads.** Release files include SHA-256 checksums. The companion verifies updates before installing them.

The current Windows installer is **not code-signed yet**, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. See the [installation guide](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/help#companion).

## Ranked play

Collect through normal play, use the addon’s trade window and keep your companion synced. Edited collections, fake progress and exploiting bugs are not allowed.

Read the [Ranked rules](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/fair-play) **before starting a Ranked binder**. Casual drops affect eligibility. You can compare public collections on the [ladder](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/ladder). Open Wanted lists from the Guild page, or type `/acb wanted`, to compare lists in game.

## Need a hand?

Open **Settings → Help** in the binder to copy a bug-report link with basic game details already filled in, check known issues or find the community.

- [Community Discord](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/discord)
- [Setup and troubleshooting](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/help)
- [Frequently asked questions](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/faq)
- [Known issues](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/KNOWN-ISSUES.md)
- [Server status](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/status)
- [Bug reports and feature requests](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/issues/new/choose)
- [Privacy and deleting your data](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/privacy)

For security issues, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/SECURITY.md). Avoid putting account files or personal information in a public issue.

**For contributors: source, builds and documentation**

The repository contains the addon, companion and server. The installed addon folder remains named `AzerothCardBinder` for compatibility with existing saved data and card links.

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `AzerothCardBinder/` | The addon, installed as it is |
| `app/` | Windows companion app, using Electron and TypeScript |
| `server/` | Cloudflare Worker, database migrations and website |
| `packages/shared/` | Shared catalog, ledger rules and test vectors |
| `tests/` | Offline Lua and shared-contract tests |
| `tools/` | Build, release, catalog and backup tools |
| `docs/` | Specifications, release planning and runbooks |

Use [LuaJIT](https://luajit.org/) and [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 24 or later. Install the app and server dependencies before running the full suite.

```sh
luajit tests/run.lua
node tools/release.js check
node tools/release.js test
node tools/release.js build
```

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), the [roadmap](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md), [ledger specification](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/docs/LEDGER-SPEC.md), [API documentation](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/docs/API.md) and [release runbook](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/docs/runbooks/RELEASES.md). Client rendering, model poses, sounds and two-player interactions also need testing inside the game.

For the release-page draft and planned screenshots, see [CurseForge release planning](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/docs/launch/CURSEFORGE-PLAN.md). Image filenames and replacement instructions are in the [media guide](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/docs/media/README.md).

## Licence and credits

Copyright © 2026 the World of Warcards contributors. Licensed under **GPL-3.0-or-later**; see [LICENSE](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/LICENSE). Catalog sources and attribution are in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/CREDITS.md).

releases.name: World of Warcards 1.1.0
releases.notes:
# World of Warcards 1.1.0

**Addon 1.1.0 · Companion 1.0.8**

## Card history

New copies remember their original finder, where they were acquired and when. Those details stay with the exact copy through gifts and trades. Inspect history in your binder, in the trade window or when viewing another player's shared binder. Choose which duplicate you want to give. Older cards show Not recorded.

## Community bonus events

We can now run scheduled bonus hours across all collections or selected zones and dungeons. A sound and chat notice announce the start, with the active bonus and countdown beside the binder title. Keep the companion connected to your Ranked binder, sync and load the schedule with `/reload` before the event starts. Dates will be announced in Discord; this update does not automatically activate a bonus.

## Campfire bonus

Campfires are part of the hunt too. While the camp buff is active, Common and Rare creature-card finds have double the chance. The Camp Benefits detection, tooltip information and movable fallback icon from the previous release remain included. Camping, trading, gifting and guild donations also offer the Fellowship cards, with their Better Together achievement and Fellow Traveler title.

## Dungeon sharing

If the client blocks automatic pickup announcements in a dungeon, a local **Share this find** link prepares the message for you. Press Enter to send it normally.

## Updating

Update **companion 1.0.8 first**, then **addon 1.1.0**. Restart the companion or choose **Check for updates**, then sync and `/reload` in game to load its reply. If that reload starts a sync, wait for it to finish and reload once more.

**Keep your existing binder and saved data.** This update does not reset your collection, packs, guild donations or progress. Both players need the current addon for history-preserving trades and gifts.

305 addon checks, 462 companion/server checks and the real packaged companion startup checks pass.

[Downloads and setup](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/download) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/266naSpg7)

Known client issue: some Forever clients can enter a minimise/restore loop near loading screens. This release does not claim to fix it. If chat responds, try `/reload`; otherwise close the game with Alt+F4 and relaunch. Unsaved finds may be lost. [Help and known issues](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/help).

releases.name: World of Warcards 1.0.21
releases.notes:
# World of Warcards 1.0.21

Harry's campfire fixes:

- The game's **Camp Benefits** buff now activates the campfire boost. Its duration determines whether it is the ordinary or violet camp buff.
- The buff's tooltip explains the boost where the client supports it. A separate icon remains available as a fallback.
- Drag the fallback icon to move it; its position is saved. Use `/acb campfire reset` to put it back, or `/acb campfire icon on`, `off` or `auto` to choose when it appears.

Keep companion **1.0.6**. If you already have it, only the addon needs updating, then `/reload` in game. Players upgrading from an older companion should update that first. Your cards, packs, guild donations and saved progress are preserved. No ledger or server rule changes are needed for these fixes.

The guild index, card selection, review, cancellation and donor-name improvements from 1.0.20 remain included.

Downloads: https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/download
Discord: https://discord.gg/266naSpg7

Known issue: some Forever clients can enter a fullscreen minimise/restore loop near loading screens. This release does not claim to fix it. If chat responds, type `/reload`; otherwise close the game with Alt+F4 and relaunch. Unsaved finds may be lost.

releases.notes:
# World of Warcards 1.0.20

Use companion **1.0.6** with addon **1.0.20**. Keep the companion open while playing Ranked. Updates preserve your collection and saved progress.

- The Guild tab opens the guild collection index. **Guild index** at the top takes you back from any section.
- **Add cards** opens your own binder. Choose cards, use **Review selected** to check the full selection and last-copy warnings, then accept the donation.
- **Keep choosing** returns to your selection. **Cancel donation** discards it and returns to the guild index. Cards only move after acceptance.
- Confirmed guild cards show their latest donating character. Older donations without a recorded character remain unnamed.
- Keep the companion open, use **Save & sync** after donating, then **Refresh after sync** once the companion finishes.
- Includes Harry's campfire boost and four Fellowship cards for camping, trading, gifting and guild donations, plus their collection achievement and title.

Help: https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/help
Discord: https://discord.gg/266naSpg7

Known issue: some Forever clients can enter a fullscreen minimise/restore loop near loading screens. This release does not claim to fix it. If chat responds, type `/reload`; otherwise close the game with Alt+F4 and relaunch. Unsaved finds may be lost.

releases.name: World of Warcards: Full guild binder and batch donations — addon 1.0.19
releases.notes:
## Guild binder and batch donations — addon 1.0.19

Keep **companion 1.0.5**. Update the addon and /reload. Your personal cards, guild cards, packs and progress are preserved.

- Browse the full Guild binder with the same searchable index, four-card pages, missing slots, model previews and collectible editions as your own binder.
- **Donate cards** opens your personal binder at a spare copy. Click cards to select them, or use **Add one copy to tray** for extra copies. Spare copies are offered first; **All owned** allows last copies.
- **Review tray** lists the complete batch. Remove cards or keep choosing before confirming. Last copies are explicitly marked and warned about. Nothing leaves your binder until you confirm.
- Confirmed batches appear immediately as **Waiting for sync** in the guild pages. Pending copies do not increase confirmed guild ownership, completion or points.
- Keep the companion open. **Save & sync** saves the whole batch with one reload; the companion syncs automatically. Once it finishes, **Refresh after sync** loads the reply. You do not need to switch apps or sync each card separately.

Donations stay with the guild permanently. Batches recheck membership, cards, ledger integrity and capacity, and use the existing per-copy signed events and receipts. The normal collection, trading and read-only binder views keep their existing behaviour.

262 Lua checks passed, including 50-copy batches, stale reviews, cancellation, duplicate clicks, last-copy protection and pending/confirmed counts. In-game layout and group donation testing remain useful.

The DX12 loading-screen issue remains under investigation; this release does not claim to fix it. [Known issues](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/KNOWN-ISSUES.md).

[Downloads](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/download) · [Guild help](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/help#guilds)

releases.name: World of Warcards: Forever full names and guilds — companion 1.0.5
releases.notes:
## Forever full names and guilds — companion 1.0.5 / addon 1.0.18

Update the companion first, then the addon and /reload. Existing cards, packs, progress, guild memberships and donations are kept.

- Forever characters use first names and surnames. The companion displays them together as a full name.
- Guild lookup uses one shared Forever world. A different surname no longer prevents joining a guild or creates a separate guild-name group.
- Existing signed character identities and collection history remain intact. Guild owners still approve member applications.

If you have already applied, click **Refresh** under Guild binder. Your guild binder owner can refresh and approve you. Then sync and /reload to load the membership into the game.

[Downloads](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/download) · [Guild help](https://worldofwarcards.co.uk/help#guilds)

The existing DX12 loading-screen issue remains under investigation; this release does not claim to fix it. [Known issues](https://github.com/Imokim2/azeroth-card-binder/blob/main/KNOWN-ISSUES.md). The Windows installer is currently unsigned; use the trusted companion updater or verify the published checksum.
